scripts.bootstrap: pnpm openas2:clean && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env down -v && pnpm infra:bootstrap-identity && pnpm infra:up && pnpm openas2:start && pnpm infra:init-edi && pnpm credentials
scripts.up: pnpm infra:up && pnpm openas2:start && pnpm services:up
scripts.up:edi: pnpm infra:up:edi && pnpm openas2:start && pnpm services:up:edi
scripts.down:edi: pnpm services:down:edi && pnpm openas2:stop && pnpm infra:down:edi
scripts.logs:edi: pnpm logs unified-api edi-as2-server platform-workers edi-cp-workers edi-dp-workers
scripts.logs:ip: pnpm logs unified-api platform-workers ip-cp-workers ip-dp-workers
scripts.logs:infra: pnpm logs postgres_global edi_postgres_shard ip_postgres_shard localstack
scripts.logs:infra:edi: pnpm logs postgres_global edi_postgres_shard localstack sftp
scripts.start:prd: turbo run build && turbo run start
scripts.db:generate: cd core/platform/packages/database && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm db:migrate:platform && pnpm db:seed && pnpm db:migrate:edi && pnpm db:migrate:ip
scripts.test:integration:pristine: pnpm db:reset:schemas && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm test:integration
scripts.test:integration:pristine:edi: pnpm db:reset:schemas:edi && pnpm db:setup:edi && pnpm test:integration:edi
scripts.test:integration:pristine:ip: pnpm db:reset:schemas:ip && pnpm db:setup:ip && pnpm test:integration:ip
scripts.db:migrate:platform: uv run python -m platform_migrator migrate --domain platform
scripts.db:seed: uv run python -m platform_migrator seed --domain all
scripts.db:seed:platform: uv run python -m platform_migrator seed --domain platform
scripts.db:seed:ucp: (cd core/ucp/packages/ucp && uv run python scripts/seed.py) && (cd core/ucp/apps/ucp-jobs-worker && uv run python scripts/seed_jobs.py)
scripts.db:seed:identity: cd core/platform/apps/identity-jobs-worker && uv run python scripts/seed_jobs.py
scripts.db:seed:edi: uv run python -m platform_migrator seed --domain edi
scripts.db:seed:ip: uv run python -m platform_migrator seed --domain ip
scripts.infra:clean-identity-org: cd core/ucp/packages/ucp && uv run python scripts/clear_zitadel.py
scripts.infra:bootstrap: pnpm openas2:clean && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env down -v && pnpm infra:bootstrap-identity && pnpm infra:up && pnpm openas2:start && pnpm infra:init-edi && pnpm credentials
scripts.infra:bootstrap:edi: pnpm openas2:clean && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env down -v && pnpm infra:bootstrap-identity && pnpm infra:up:edi && pnpm openas2:start && pnpm infra:init-edi && pnpm credentials
scripts.infra:bootstrap:ip: docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env down -v && pnpm infra:bootstrap-identity && pnpm infra:up:ip && pnpm credentials
scripts.infra:up: pnpm infra:sync-topology && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env up -d --wait postgres_global edi_postgres_shard ip_postgres_shard localstack sftp && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env -f docker-compose.identity.yml up -d && pnpm db:migrate:platform && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env run -T --rm db-seed && pnpm db:migrate:edi && pnpm db:migrate:ip
scripts.infra:up:edi: pnpm infra:sync-topology:edi && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env up -d --wait postgres_global edi_postgres_shard localstack sftp && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env -f docker-compose.identity.yml up -d && pnpm db:migrate:platform && pnpm db:seed:platform && pnpm db:seed:edi && pnpm db:migrate:edi
scripts.infra:up:ip: pnpm infra:sync-topology:ip && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env up -d --wait postgres_global ip_postgres_shard localstack && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env -f docker-compose.identity.yml up -d && pnpm db:migrate:platform && pnpm db:seed:platform && pnpm db:seed:ip && pnpm db:migrate:ip
scripts.infra:down: docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env down && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env -f docker-compose.identity.yml down
scripts.infra:down:edi: docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env stop edi_postgres_shard sftp
scripts.infra-reset: pnpm openas2:clean && pnpm infra:clean-identity-org && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env down -v && pnpm infra:up && pnpm openas2:start && pnpm infra:init-edi && pnpm credentials
scripts.infra-reset:edi: pnpm openas2:clean && pnpm infra:clean-identity-org && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env down -v && pnpm infra:up:edi && pnpm openas2:start && pnpm infra:init-edi && pnpm credentials
scripts.infra-reset:ip: pnpm infra:clean-identity-org && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env down -v && pnpm infra:up:ip && pnpm credentials
scripts.openas2:start: docker image inspect openas2-openas2:3.3.0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || (docker image inspect openas2-openas2:latest >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker tag openas2-openas2:latest openas2-openas2:3.3.0) || true; docker network inspect soopa_mono_default >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker network create soopa_mono_default; docker compose -f tools/openas2/docker-compose.yml up --build -d
scripts.infra-restart: docker compose restart postgres_global edi_postgres_shard ip_postgres_shard localstack
scripts.infra:restart:edi: docker compose restart postgres_global edi_postgres_shard localstack sftp
scripts.infra:restart:ip: docker compose restart postgres_global ip_postgres_shard localstack
scripts.db:setup:edi: pnpm db:migrate:platform && pnpm db:seed:platform && pnpm db:seed:edi && pnpm db:migrate:edi
scripts.db:setup:ip: pnpm db:migrate:platform && pnpm db:seed:platform && pnpm db:seed:ip && pnpm db:migrate:ip
scripts.services:up: pnpm services:build && docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env up -d unified-api edi-as2-server platform-workers edi-cp-workers edi-dp-workers ip-cp-workers ip-dp-workers
scripts.services:up:edi: pnpm services:build && ENABLED_APPS=edi docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env --profile edi up -d unified-api edi-as2-server platform-workers edi-cp-workers edi-dp-workers
scripts.services:up:ip: pnpm services:build && ENABLED_APPS=ip docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env --profile ip up -d unified-api platform-workers ip-cp-workers ip-dp-workers
scripts.services:down: docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env stop unified-api edi-as2-server platform-workers edi-cp-workers edi-dp-workers ip-cp-workers ip-dp-workers
scripts.services:down:edi: docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env stop unified-api edi-as2-server platform-workers edi-cp-workers edi-dp-workers
scripts.services:down:ip: docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env stop unified-api platform-workers ip-cp-workers ip-dp-workers
scripts.services:restart: docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env restart unified-api edi-as2-server platform-workers edi-cp-workers edi-dp-workers ip-cp-workers ip-dp-workers
scripts.services:restart:edi: docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env restart unified-api edi-as2-server platform-workers edi-cp-workers edi-dp-workers
scripts.services:restart:ip: docker compose --env-file .env --env-file versions.env restart unified-api platform-workers ip-cp-workers ip-dp-workers
scripts.ucp-reset: pnpm infra:clean-identity-org && pnpm infra:down && pnpm infra:up
scripts.soft-reset: pnpm infra:clean-identity-org && cd apps/edi && make sqs-purge
